coordinate_system: Normalized x,y on the full approved background plate: (0,0) top left; (1,1) bottom right. Actor contact_xy is the grounded paw/body support point on that plate before any registered crop.

cast_scale.measurement_note: The collage crops Leo, so 0.40 is a chosen anatomical staging target that recreates the liked balance; it is not claimed as a measured ratio from that cropped image. Verify with a same-ground-plane neutral lineup before approving final keyframes.
cast_scale.definition: Milo: ear tips to planted feet in upright neutral pose. Leo: mane top to supporting front paws in quadrupedal neutral pose. Compare at the same depth and camera; sitting or lying changes pose-box height but not anatomy.
cast_scale.rule: Never enlarge Milo merely because Leo is present or shrink him merely because he is alone. Use the same physical ratio at equal depth; change apparent size for depth or an explicitly registered camera crop.

depth_model.equation: apparent standing-equivalent frame height = wide foreground base height × (0.55 + 0.45 × depth_t) × registered view magnification
depth_model.depth_t_definition: 0 is far end of the named walkable zone, 1 is near foreground end; infer depth from contact point on the approved plate, not from an arbitrary label.
depth_model.movement_rule: For a fixed camera and plate, interpolate depth_t and position continuously between key poses. Recompute apparent size from the depth equation at every step. A change of depth_t by 0.10 changes apparent height by roughly 5–8%, while a move from the near to far end makes it about 55% of near size. A larger jump needs a visibly larger depth move or an explicitly registered camera cut.
depth_model.camera_rule: A different view magnification is a camera crop of the same approved plate. It changes frame fraction without changing anatomy; record the cut and derive it from the approved master. Do not treat a crop as character growth.
depth_model.pose_rule: Standing-equivalent height is the anatomical reference. Sitting, lying, running and reaching alter the visible pose box while head, mane, torso and limb size remain coherent.

wide.rule: Use the complete approved plate and established horizon.

medium_solo.rule: Crop the approved plate around one character and nearby landmark; preserve the original geometry.

medium_two.rule: Crop the same approved plate around both characters, matching the liked Scene 06 upper-right balance.

close_two.rule: Closer registered crop of the same plate around both characters, matching the liked Scene 06 lower-panel balance.

close_solo.rule: Crop the approved plate around one face/body; retain the character’s anatomical scale.

detail_insert.rule: Crop the approved plate and prop action; this is an insert, not a new location or identity/size anchor.

grass_lane.description: The foreground grass bank; stream, berry crown, log roof and decorative rocks are not footing. Keep the stream behind Milo and the feeding stone at frame right.
Same stream-bank geometry in sunset light; the feeding stone and left berry bush remain fixed.

dirt_fork.description: The dirt junction and its two continuous branches; the central mossy boulder is not footing.

landmarks: left safe branch and meadow opening

dirt_lane.description: The uninterrupted dirt lane below the raised branch; stone and stump stay beside, not under, the feet.

clearing_path.description: Open clearing and path in front of the great tree. Leo stays left of the trunk; Milo can approach along the path beside Leo, with paws off the raised roots.

landmarks: center-right oak trunk and root fan

clearing_path.description: Same great-tree ground geometry in daylight. Keep the trunk and major roots behind the pair.

landmarks: center-right oak trunk and root fan

dirt_path.description: Continuous dirt path beneath the overhead branch. Leo and the net occupy the center lane; Milo reaches only the closure strand at Leo’s flank.
Continuous dirt lane between roots and bushes. The roots may be stepped over, not used as floating support.

invalid_support_zones: decorative roots away from the path

home_path.description: Dirt path leading to the burrow threshold; the stump roof and vegetation are not footing.

landmarks: stump and round burrow at right

frames.action: Milo explores the continuous foreground grass lane beneath the trees; keep him small within the wide landscape.
Milo pauses beside the far-left berry bush and hollow log, curious but standing on the grass lane.
Milo follows the winding bank path a little farther from the stream-side stone.
Milo sits safely on the grass beside the path, holding and nibbling a single acorn; keep the stream behind him.
Milo looks up as warm afternoon light fades and long soft shadows stretch across the bank.
Milo stands on the grass lane, ears raised and mouth open for his brief spoken exclamation; the acorn stays in his paws.
Milo sets the acorn beside the flat stone, with both feet on the bank and the water clearly separate.
Wide establishing view of the fork around the central mossy boulder; both dirt branches are visible.
Milo looks from the safe left meadow route toward the darker right shortcut, standing on the path.
Milo pauses on the path and looks toward the darkening sky; show one still moment with the long safe path and shortcut visible behind him.
Milo points his body toward the shortcut and speaks with a determined open mouth, still grounded on the path.
Milo hurries past the left mossy stone along the uninterrupted foreground running lane.
Milo ducks beneath the raised fallen branch while remaining on the path; branch stays overhead.
Milo curves around the right stump on the clear lane; no stepping on stump or foliage.
Side view: Milo runs faster toward the distant opening, planted foot action readable and tail trailing naturally.
Leo sleeps on his side beneath the great oak, all four paws/body supported by the clearing; one large paw rests across the path.
Milo rounds a visible root, catches his balance, and exclaims in a startled open-mouth beat before tumbling beside the paw.
Milo completes one small roll and lands safely against Leo’s nose; maintain gentle contact and keep Leo asleep.
Leo opens his eyes and lifts his head; in the last beat he asks what happened with a speaking mouth, Milo remains silent.
Leo lifts his head in surprise while Milo scrambles down to the clear dirt-and-grass path.
Leo places a paw beside Milo on the path, blocking the exit without pinning or touching him.
Milo freezes beneath Leo’s calm but imposing presence; keep visible ground under both characters and emphasize the scale difference.
Leo asks why Milo raced through, mouth open only for Leo’s dialogue; Milo looks up from the path.
Milo apologizes and explains he was eating by the stream; Milo mouth open for his dialogue, Leo listens silently.
Milo explains he took a shortcut to get home before dark; keep his feet planted.
Milo promises he did not mean to disturb Leo; Leo’s paw remains beside, not on, Milo.
Milo trembles on the path as Leo looks down; Leo’s expression gradually softens, no narrator-driven mouth movement.
Leo speaks gently and gives Milo permission to go; open mouth only on Leo’s dialogue beat.
Milo looks up in surprised relief and asks if Leo is letting him go; open mouth only on Milo’s line.
Leo reassures him, then Milo’s expression shifts from fear to gratitude; dialogue mouths stay silent during narration.
Milo thanks Leo and promises to pass kindness on; Milo speaks, Leo listens.
Leo answers, then gently sends Milo home before the stars; show the open path and evening sky.
Milo hurries toward home but now chooses careful steps along a grounded path.
A gentle passage-of-days visual: same forest route in changing light, Milo resumes ordinary routines.
Leo rests beneath the same great tree, four paws supported by ground.
Empty established shortcut path recedes into the dim opening, foreshadowing the friends meeting again; no new forest location or characters.
Leo walks along the trap path; a subtle leaf-covered trigger sits on the path ahead, not floating.
Leo steps closer, one paw approaches the trigger on the ground.
The net drops from the overhead branch and settles loosely around Leo’s back, shoulders, flanks and legs; preserve a clear opening around his entire face and keep all four paws on the path.
Leo makes one careful tug against the net; open diamond mesh supports around his body but leaves his face entirely clear and all paws on the path.
Leo speaks in frustration while trying once more; his face is unobstructed, mouth opens only for his dialogue, and the net stays intact around his body.
Leo pauses, breathing heavily beneath the loose body net; face and four grounded paws remain clear.
Leo raises his head and calls for help; his face stays completely outside the net mesh, four paws grounded, no ropes across eyes or muzzle.
Milo’s ears lift at the distant call; he recognizes it and turns toward the sound.
Milo calls “The lion!” with an open mouth for his line, standing on the path.
Milo runs along the continuous lane, stepping over a low root and passing between bushes without leaving the path.
Milo runs with purpose toward the bright opening; show stable scale progression into depth.
Milo arrives on the clear path and sees Leo beneath the net; keep net and all landmarks readable.
Leo warns Milo to stay back and says the ropes are too strong; mouth open for Leo, all paws still supported.
Milo carefully studies the mesh and steps toward the single closure loop; he stays outside tangled strands.
Milo explains that his teeth may help; his mouth opens for his own dialogue, paws reach the net edge.
Leo reacts with surprise and asks about Milo’s teeth; open mouth for Leo only.
Milo answers playfully; his teeth remain small and natural, and no rope has been cut yet.
Milo steadies a single net closure strand at Leo’s flank and begins to gnaw; keep all rope entirely behind Leo’s shoulder and body, with a completely clear head and muzzle.
Close detail of Milo holding the closure strand with both paws and taking small bites; show only Milo and rope, not Leo’s face.
Wider view: Milo bites the same closure loop beside Leo’s flank; Leo watches with his entire face free of every strand and all four paws grounded.
Extreme close detail of fibers fraying on the exact strand at Milo’s teeth; do not show rope crossing Leo’s head.
The same closure strand parts at its frayed point; the rest of the net remains intact and no rope touches Leo’s face.
Milo steps clear, the opening widens, and Leo carefully steps out; net slips behind his body and stays off his face, paws touch the path.
Leo thanks Milo; Milo answers playfully; a two-shot shows the great lion looking at the tiny mouse with gratitude.
Leo asks about repaying kindness and Milo replies; alternate speaking mouth only for the named line speaker.
Milo explains that kindness is not a debt; Leo listens, then asks what Milo means.
Milo says he helped someone in need and hopes kindness will pass on; use a warm medium two-shot.
Leo falls quiet as he reconsiders strength; close on his reflective face with mouth closed during narration.
Leo understands gentleness as strength and smiles; Milo remains beside him, both supported on the path.
Later in daylight, Leo and Milo rest together on the open ground beneath the great oak.
Leo jokes warmly that Milo has large ideas; open mouth only on Leo’s spoken line.
Milo replies that he has useful teeth; open mouth only on Milo’s line.
The friends laugh together; laughter is a visible action, not narrator lip-sync.
A peaceful closing sequence beneath the tree: two friends share the lesson of passing kindness on; keep both characters silent during narrator voice-over.
